end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of 2D shapes.
Counted four sides and four corners using lines and corners.
Identified a triangle from three sides and three corners, including when tilted.
Teach-back was not passed; requested a game during practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting each line and then checking the corners, including for shapes in different positions. Ayaan used this method to identify a triangle and later stated that it has 3 sides and 3 corners. They briefly mixed up the count while returning to the star shape, and this was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to find household objects and count their sides and corners together.
